impact.note: Graph zero is not evidence of no impact. Existing partner tool list and public export still reference Apollo.

changes: Reuse existing provider-http without modifying the helper.
One 30000ms budget, including headers/body/parse and final projection check.
Bound response to 1048576 actual received bytes, reject redirects, omit credentials, release or cancel bodies best effort.
Snapshot and validate own plain data parameters before network; no getters.
Reject malformed responses and explicit provider failure flags rather than reporting an invented empty success.
Return at most requested limit and only name/email/organization; unavailable optional strings normalized to null.
Return fixed provider error message without body, diagnostics or provider extras.
